audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer row read 'Skill' while content win[] and the packet chart both read Vex/Vex/Vex/Vex/Fizz/Fizz/Fizz.
audit.why: Vex owns levels 1-5: Doom 'n Gloom fears and interrupts dashes, and both of Fizz's entrances are dashes, while Mistral Bolt pokes from 1200 on 8s at rank 1. From 6 the shark opens fights from 1300 without dashing at all, which is what flips the chart.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content/packet verdicts with all seven whys rewritten to argue the same side; rows 0-3 rated 4/10.

audit.why: Level 6 is the real spike and the reason is now stated: Chum the Waters is a 1300-range projectile, so it is the one commit that does not feed her dash-punish passive. Shadow Surge is 140/120/100s, which is the late-game window.
audit.corrected: Spike reasoning tightened in spikes[1], spikes[3] and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The fear was labelled 'Personal Space (Fear)' across focus, cooldowns, dos/donts and report[5], and the ultimate was called 'Doom's Call' in four content fields. spikes[1] called Shadow Surge her E.
audit.why: Per the kit: the fear is the passive, Doom 'n Gloom — it empowers her next basic ability to fear and interrupt dashes, and every nearby enemy dash marks her target and shortens the empowered cooldown. Personal Space is the W: a 16/15/14/13/12s shield with nearby damage at 475. E is Looming Darkness (flat 12s, 800, slow and Gloom). R is Shadow Surge, a marking missile with a recast dash.
audit.corrected: Fear renamed to Doom 'n Gloom throughout the fields I touched; Personal Space described as the shield; Shadow Surge given its correct slot and 100s late cooldown. The interaction that matters — her passive interrupts dashes, so enter on foot and keep the pole as an exit — is now stated in cooldowns, dos, donts and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second invitation' with no source.
audit.why: Mistral Bolt is 8s at rank 1, Looming Darkness a flat 12s, Personal Space 16s at rank 1, Playful/Trickster 16s at rank 1. The empowered-pulse timer is not in Riot's text, so no number can be asserted for it.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in; the unsourced fifteen seconds removed rather than replaced with a guess.

audit.why: Vex is she/her. Fizz's Q is a 550-range dash onto a target, not poke — following that advice walks you into the fear.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, both bled bullets rewritten, wants.you[1] changed to W-empowered autos.

edits.before: Vex's Personal Space passive fears you the instant you dash within range, which directly punishes Playful/Trickster and E-jump engages, so before level 6 you need to farm with auto-attacks and Seastone procs rather than diving in recklessly. She'll poke you down with Mistral Bolt and look to stack passive charges for a fear-into-burst combo, and without your full kit online you don't have a great answer to that pressure. Play patient, ward for her jungler, and avoid overextending into uncontested Q poke.

She'll poke you down with Mistral Bolt from 1200 and hold the charged pulse for a fear-into-burst combo, and without your full kit online you don't have a great answer to that pressure. Play patient, ward for her jungler, and avoid overextending into uncontested Q poke.

edits.before: At level 6 your ult grants a dash which can still eat a fear if she's in range, but the extra mobility, damage, and repositioning it offers means you finally have tools to punish her cooldowns and pick your engage timing. She'll look for Doom's Call fear setups to combo you down from range, so bait out her E and Q before committing your all-in. This phase is closer to even-to-your-favour as your kit comes online and her early poke advantage fades.
edits.after: At level 6 Chum the Waters throws from 1300 and involves no dash at all, so it is the one opener her passive cannot interrupt — the knockup and slow finally let you punish her cooldowns and pick your engage timing. This phase is closer to even-to-your-favour as your kit comes online and her early poke advantage fades.

edits.before: Vex has no real scaling beyond poke damage and a long-cooldown fear ultimate, so by the time you have core items your burst combo and mobility let you run her down or simply out-rotate her around the map. Keep pressuring side lanes and picking off her when she's away from her fear-window setup, and avoid grouping into stagnant fights where Doom's Call can lock down your carries. This is squarely your win condition once teamfights favour dive comps.

notes:
Two systemic name errors here. (1) The fear was labelled 'Personal Space (Fear)' everywhere; Personal Space is her W, a 16/15/14/13/12s shield at 475 range. The fear is the passive Doom 'n Gloom, which empowers her next ability to fear AND interrupt dashes — that distinction matters because Fizz's Q and the second cast of his E are both dashes, so the correct advice is to walk into trades and keep the pole as an exit. (2) The content layer called her ultimate 'Doom's Call' in four places; it is Shadow Surge (140/120/100s), and spikes[1] additionally gave it the E slot. All corrected. focus.text is exactly 25 characters ('Vex Personal Space (Fear)'), right at the applier's 25-char skip threshold — if that edit is dropped, the focus label will still carry the wrong ability name and needs a manual fix. The full-layer chart was 'Skill' on all seven rows against a content chart of Vex/Vex/Vex/Vex/Fizz/Fizz/Fizz; I moved full onto content and rewrote every why, so no win[N] edits were required. The packet suspectName on 'Her Mistral Bolt' is a false positive — the name is correct.
